lines: Analogue snare drum voice with a tuned body, a separate noise section, a pitch envelope and an accent input
Sets the pitch of the drum body
Attenuates the voltage at the PITCH FM input before it is added to the body pitch
Voltage control of the body pitch, halved and then scaled by the PITCH FM knob
Sets how long the drum body rings on after a trigger
Attenuates the voltage at the decay MOD input before it lengthens or shortens the body decay
Voltage control of the body decay, scaled by the decay MOD knob
Sets how far the pitch envelope bends the body pitch away from the tuned pitch
Sets how quickly the pitch envelope falls back to the tuned pitch
Voltage control of the pitch envelope decay: 0V leaves it as set, 1V doubles it and -1V collapses it to nothing
Sets the output level of the drum
Attenuates the voltage at the level MOD input before it raises or lowers the output level
Voltage control of the output level, scaled by a fifth and then by the level MOD knob
Sets the balance between the tuned drum body and the noise
Sets how long the noise rings on after a trigger
Sets the cutoff of the high-pass filter on the drum
Sets how much louder a hit is when a gate is present at the ACCENT input as the drum is triggered
A rising edge to 1V or more fires the drum
A gate of 1V or more here at the moment of a trigger makes that hit louder, by the amount set by the ACCENT knob
The drum, as a single audio signal
Menu — Old Model (obsolete) switches the voice back to the earlier snare this module used
SnareDrum-VCV.notes: Outputs 0 and 1 are declared in the code but have no widget on the panel, so they cannot be clicked and are left untagged; only output 2, printed OUT, carries the drum. Parameters 2 and 3 likewise have no widget. The maker configured no names for this module's jacks, so every line here comes from the rendered panel and from the module's process code in the installed 2.2.5 binary.

Deep.notes: Outputs 0 and 1 are declared in the code but have no widget on the panel and are left untagged; only output 2, printed OUT, carries the drum. Parameter 2 likewise has no widget. The maker named parameter 10 model and the code passes its position to a waveshaper, which is why the line calls it a drive circuit. The accent jack is printed ACC. and the accent knob ACCENT.
